purpose.summary: This program generates a periodic summary/control report of salary codes (codes salaire) for employees. It reads payroll data from a CODPAIE indexed file, filters by firm, employee, and month range, matches against configured salary code parameters, and writes results to a CSV-like sequential output file (TF-CSM) for export or further processing.

notable_features: ACUCOBOL-GT screen I/O: ACCEPT with LINE/POSITION/TAB/UPDATE/NO BEEP/CURSOR/CONTROL clauses
CALL 'C$RERR' for extended file error handling — ACUCOBOL-GT runtime
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR PROCEDURE
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING — subprogram/called module pattern
Multiple COPY statements for shared record layouts (.REC, .CPY, .FC, .FDE)
REDEFINES used extensively for dual numeric/text field access
OCCURS clause on TF-DONNEES for multi-value output fields
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for CSV-style export
French-language comments and variable names (AVANT, APRES, AFFICHAGE, etc.)
Function key control via EXC-KFR array (ACUCOBOL-GT key management)
verdict.notes: The program is clearly part of a larger French-language payroll application suite (module names like 6-CODSAL, 6-REGIS, 6-CARRI, 4-CSTAB suggest a numbered module architecture). The box-drawing characters in comments (Ú, Ä, ¿, À, ³) are CP850/latin-1 encoded, consistent with the latin-1 decoding reported. The source was truncated at 16000 chars out of 22578 bytes, so the latter portion of the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not visible, but the overall structure is clear.
